title: Gallery | My Claude Code
description: Every reviewed screenshot of My Claude Code, grouped by area and captioned: the dashboard, the request log, the model catalogue, search, agents and media.
intro: These are the product's own captures, reviewed one by one before publication. Each was checked for keys, tokens, account names, file paths and real prompt text; where a capture carried something that did not belong on a public page, it was redacted on a copy and the original was left untouched. Every image below has a caption, and every caption describes the state the screen is actually in. Together they are the LLM dashboard screenshots: the control plane, the request log and the agent pages, as they actually look.

blocks.text: The screens are grouped by the area of the product they belong to, in the same order as the features: the dashboard itself, providers and credentials, routing, reasoning and limits, observability and cost, web search, agents, media and messaging. A capture appears once, in the group where it is most useful.
A capture shows the version that was running when it was taken. The version panel in each screen is the honest record; the current release is on the home page.

blocks.text: Every tracked image in the repository was inventoried, hashed and de-duplicated first. The survivors were reviewed on contact sheets and, where a leak was plausible, at full resolution. The verdicts were include, redact or exclude with a reason. Redactions are solid rectangles applied to a copy, and each rectangle is recorded with its coordinates. The excluded captures are the ones that were not product screens, or that could not be cleaned without destroying what they showed.
